TensorRT = any model. TensorRT-LLM = LLMs only (KV-cache, in-flight batching).
cuDF/Pandas same API. Just import cudf. GPU-accelerated, minimal code changes.
Triton: dynamic batching = #1 production feature. Supports HTTP + gRPC.
NeMo Guardrails + Colang — 2-3 questions. Topical/Safety/Security/Fact rails.
BERT = encoder = understanding/classification. GPT = decoder = generation.
RAG for external/live knowledge. Fine-tuning for style/behavior change.
RLHF: Pre-train → SFT → Reward Model → PPO. How ChatGPT was aligned.
~1 min per question. Flag + return. Don't overthink distractor answers.
